title: Cooperative prefetch eviction marketplace for prefix-safe KV reclamation
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Design and implement a cooperative eviction protocol that 1) harmonizes LRU and TTL signals with explicit prefix affinity, 2) exposes short-term lease semantics to continuous batching so in-flight batches never observe evicted prefixes, and 3) integrates with the GPU allocator to minimize memory fragmentation during batch-driven prefetches. Goal is correctness guarantees (no stale prefix reads) while keeping GPU memory footprint and end-to-end latency within SLOs.
acceptance_criteria: Formal invariants documented: prefix-safety, lease-driven eviction ordering, and eventual reclamation
Implementation exposes a prefix-lease API consumed by continuous-batching runtime: acquire_lease(prefix, epoch), release_lease(prefix, epoch)
End-to-end integration tests that simulate concurrent batch serving + eviction show zero stale-read failures across 1M synthetic requests
Benchmarks: median token latency regression < 5% and GPU memory savings >= 8% for mixed LRU/TTL workloads compared to baseline
GPU memory defragmentation path validated on p4d and a100 instances with <2% allocation overhead
comments: 2026-02-24 - Aisha Khan: Kickoff. Noting overlap with prior eviction work; want to avoid duplicating lease coordinator designs from ENG-39501. Primary difference: explicit prefetch-aware leases and GPU allocator hooks.

2026-02-26 - Marcus Lee: Proposed protocol sketch: maintain per-prefix epoch counter, leases bump epoch while held; eviction selects candidates only if candidate_epoch > max_live_epoch - safety_margin. Suggest TTL as a soft signal that lowers candidate priority rather than immediate eviction.

2026-03-01 - Eleanor Park: Implemented prototype of lease API in runtime shim. API shape: lease_acquire(prefix, holder_id, ttl_ms) -> lease_token; lease_release(lease_token) -> ok. Added quick integration test that prevents eviction while a lease exists.

2026-03-04 - Design review (with PM/Eng): Decided to combine LRU score with TTL decay and prefix affinity multiplier. Prefix affinity computed from recent batch hotness (last N batches). Prefetches increase hotness, thus raising retention priority for short window.

2026-03-06 - Performance note: Initial prototype caused increased fragmentation on GPU when many small prefix tensors were prefetched; follow-up: add coalesced allocation path and short-lived staging arena to aggregate small prefetches.

2026-03-08 - QA: Found race where lease tokens were not invalidated when model rollback occurred. Temporary mitigation: block rollouts while lease drain in progress. Plan to add atomic invalidation fence tied to rollout commit.

2026-03-10 - Eleanor Park: Added instrumentation hooks (lease_acquire latency, eviction_candidate_age, prefix_hotness) to console dashboard. Starting long-run correctness test against churny workload (mix of TTL-heavy and prefix-heavy traffic).
implementation_notes: Epoch-based leases: Each prefix has a monotonic epoch; a lease records the epoch it observed; eviction increments epoch and only reclaims when no active lease references older epochs.
Lease semantics are intentionally short-lived (default 150ms) to align with continuous-batching time windows, configurable per-customer workload.
Eviction scoring: score = base_lru_score * ttl_decay_multiplier * (1 - prefix_affinity), where prefix_affinity is normalized 0..1 from recent prefetch hits.
GPU allocator integration: introduce staging arena for transient prefetch tensors; on arena drain compact large contiguous blocks back into main allocator to reduce fragmentation.
Atomic invalidation fence: rollout/rollback path must increment a global fencing counter. All active leases observe fence and self-expire if fence > lease_fence_at_acquire.
Fallback: when lease system fails or disabled, fall back to conservative keep-on-prefetch policy and route noisy prefixes to host-memory caching to avoid GPU OOMs.
Testing: property-based tests to assert prefix-safety under interleavings; stress test mixes TTL-eviction daemon with heavy simultaneous prefetch bursts and model reloads.
Observability: emit per-prefix metrics (leases_active, last_prefetch_ts, eviction_attempts, reclaimed_bytes) and tape recordings for failing E2E runs to reproduce races.
Rollout plan: start behind config flag in runtime-2.3 on dedicated canaries (5%) then ramp to 50% after 1 week of zero correctness regressions, full rollout after perf goals met.
